thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Elevated 5xx and request timeouts for /v1/chat in ap-southeast-1. Auto-pager to primary.

nina: I'm the scheduled primary but AFK for a few hours (unexpected family thing). I posted a note in rotation but no taker yet. Can someone cover a 20m hot handoff?

oncall-rotation: @nina received. tagging @raj and @ethan for potential short coverage. Sophie, any chance you can take bridge?

sophie: I can take a 20-30m bridge. Please hand off. What's the current customer impact?

incident-bot: Snapshot: 5xx rate 35% -> spikes correlated with long-context requests. Error traces show runtime OOMs in model-worker pods: `inference-worker-*-oom` and gRPC stream resets. Affected customers: hosted tier and one dedicated customer in ap-southeast-1.

raj: I see lots of `runtime::kv_cache_growth` logs and memory pressure. Might be a runaway request with huge prompt. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-ooms (section: emergency fallback routing).

ethan: Quick mitigation checklist from runbook: (1) enable request size limit on gateway (2) divert traffic to smaller model variant in region (3) temporarily scale up model-worker memory if autoscaler lagging.

sophie: Taking bridge. I'm primary for now. Raj, can you be secondary? Nina, confirm handoff?

nina: Confirming handoff to @sophie. Sorry team — I'm offline for family. Thanks Sophie.

sophie: Action 1 - enable limit: `kubectl -n gateway patch config gateway-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/max_request_tokens","value":12000}]'` Applying.

incident-bot: Config change detected by deploy-bot: gateway-config updated (rev 2026.03.14-bridge-1). Watch for rejecting huge requests.

raj: Noticed a dedicated customer's client doing large batch sends. I've DM'd their account rep to throttle. Meanwhile scaling: `k scale deploy model-worker-apse1 --replicas=8 -n inference` to give breathing room.

ethan: Also flipping runtime circuit-breaker to prevent multi-stage failure: `redwoodctl runtime set-circuit model-worker --max-concurrency 16 --backoff 10s`. Applying.

sophie: After enabling limits and scaling, 5xx dropped to ~9% in 45s. p95 latency improved. Still watching for OOM events.

raj: One worker pod is still OOMKilled repeatedly. Draining it and rolling with increased memory: `kubectl set resources deployment model-worker --limits=memory=18Gi -n inference` then restart.

nina: Thanks all. I'm available via DM if anything escalates in the next hour.

incident-bot: Bridge created by sophie for monitoring: https://zoom.redwood/bridge/2176543219 (15m scheduled). Severity set SEV2 -> monitoring.

ethan: I'm going to create a temporary blacklist for the offending API key to stop repeat huge requests while we investigate. Command: `redwoodctl keys block --key ABC-REDACTED --reason "excessive batch size"`.

sophie: Good call. That should reduce noise. 5xx now ~3% last 2m.

raj: After restart with bigger memory, worker pods stable. No further OOMs. I recommend an infra follow-up to tune autoscaler CPU/memory thresholds and add request size-based autoscaling.

sophie: Drafting customer impact note for #support: "Brief spike of 5xx errors for /v1/chat in ap-southeast-1 between 03:05-03:20 UTC. Root cause: oversized requests caused model-worker OOMs; mitigations: request size limit, routing to smaller variant, scaled workers, blocked offending key. No data loss. Postmortem to follow." Add any edits?

ethan: Add that we enabled circuit-breaker and adjusted memory for model-worker. Also mention dedicated customer throttling.

sophie: Added. Posting now.

nina: I'll own the postmortem. Plan: collect runtime traces, account logs for offending key, autoscaler metrics, and propose threshold changes. Aim to post within 48h.

incident-bot: Postmortem owner assigned: nina. Playbook next step: add remediation PR and customer outreach within 72h.

oncall-rotation: Handback: restoring primary to scheduled rotation. Thanks @sophie and @raj for stepping in.

sophie: Handing back to rotation. Leaving bridge in 5m but will stay reachable for questions.

raj: Staying as secondary for remainder of shift.

nina: Appreciate the coverage — will sync with rotation to ensure better holiday backups.

incident-bot: Thread status: mitigated -> archived after bridge close.
